jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer II
jobs.description_text: ROCKET LAB ROBOTICS At Rocket Lab Robotics, we build robotic systems that push the boundaries of what's possible in space. From Mars-proven robotic arms to precision motion control systems for the most demanding environments in our solar system, our team delivers advanced electro-mechanical solutions for planetary exploration and various satellite programs. We've engineered hardware that has operated on the surface of Mars on NASA's Perseverance rover, supported lunar exploration through the CADRE rover program, and developed precision mechanisms for spacecraft subsystems including solar array drives, antenna gimbals, and optical payloads. As part of Rocket Lab, we combine the focus of small, dedicated robotics teams with the resources of a leading end-to-end space company, empowering some of the boldest missions in history. We're looking for people who take ownership and drive a problem from first principles all the way through manufacturing and delivery. Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions. Advance model robustness and generalization, addressing long-tail conditions such as low visibility, occlusions, and rare scene configurations. Establish evaluation frameworks for geometric accuracy, temporal stability, and cross-domain transfer performance.

It is pulsing through economies, but often goes unrecognized. We’re creating a new beat to fix that. This correspondent will reveal the economic implications of a warming planet. It’s one of the most significant coverage areas in the world today, touching on energy and trade, shifting global economic alliances and the complex calculations being made by societies that may determine prosperity or poverty for generations. jobs.description_text: Schedule: Full Time Job Type: Hybrid Salary Type: Salary Req #: 3251 About the Role Marketplace Integrity and Growth delivers impact by sourcing and developing the carrier capacity needed to meet shipper transportation needs predictability, high performance - all while protecting against bad actors and fraud vectors. The scope of this role covers carrier onboarding, carrier management, carrier engagement, carrier performance monitoring, risk & fraud-ML models and carrier access restrictions. We’re looking for a data-fluent, entrepreneurial Product Manager who thrives in ambiguity and loves building platforms and customer experiences that drive measurable customer and business value. As the Staff Marketplace Growth and Integrity Product Manager , you’ll define and deliver critical capabilities to build our carrier network - maximizing active carrier supply while rigorously mitigating risks such as fraud, compliance and suboptimal performance. This includes creating proactive and directed outreach mechanisms, building a seamless carrier onboarding experience that balances fraud and liquidity, developing state of the art fraud detection mechanisms, and managing carrier performance. You will partner with AI tools, engineers building at scale, product designers, data scientists, risk/compliance partners, marketing teams, and operations teams to shape the future of products in logistics. jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager, LTL
jobs.description_text: Schedule: Full Time Job Type: Hybrid Salary Type: Salary Req #: 3331 The Strategic Account Manager (SAM) — LTL SME owns the ultimate health, retention, strategic growth, and overall performance of assigned accounts, serving as the primary authority on Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) strategy and network optimization. While relying on Operations Account Managers (OAMs) and execution teams for daily freight movement, the SAM remains fully accountable for program outcomes. This role bridges the gap between high-level account strategy and operational execution—partnering closely with LTL Procurement and mixed TL/LTL operations teams to drive cost savings, service excellence, and value delivery across the customer's network. Core Responsibilities & Execution Pillars 1. LTL Program Management & Strategic Optimization Network & Strategy Alignment: Drive overarching LTL strategy across procurement and operations, acting as the subject-matter expert to align daily execution with macro account goals. Deep-Dive Analytics: Perform deep-dive program analyses to identify cost, service, and efficiency insights; translate raw data into actionable strategic initiatives (e.g., mode conversions, lane optimization, pooling, and drop trailer strategies). Continuous Improvement: Identify process gaps, evaluate broader market dynamics, and champion LTL best practices across the account team. 2.
